subject: dartR has been updated on GitHub.

messages.author: bfff86a70841d7e1
messages.subject: dartR has been updated on GitHub.
parts:
Quite a few new features. In particular, read depth is added to the locus metadata, report functions have been improved, v parameter replaced with 'verbose', additional error trapping, some new conversions (e.g. gl2bayescan). To install

install.packages("devtools")

library(devtools)

install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install(c("SNPRelate", "qvalue"))

install_github("green-striped-gecko/dartR")

library(dartR)

Let us know if you have any issues.

A
